resume_text:
Alex Rivera
Senior Frontend Architect & Engineer | San Francisco, CA

Executive Summary:
Senior Frontend Engineer with 7+ years of experience crafting scalable, high-performance web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js. Specialist in client-side system design, micro-frontend architecture (Module Federation), Core Web Vitals optimization, and robust state management for complex enterprise platforms.

Technical Skills:
- Frontend Core: JavaScript (ES2024+), TypeScript, React 18/19, Next.js 14, HTML5, CSS3/Sass, Tailwind CSS
- State & Data: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query (TanStack Query), GraphQL (Apollo Client)
- Build & Tooling: Webpack 5, Vite, Babel, ESLint, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright
- Performance & Security: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), DOM Virtualization, CSP, XSS Sanitization, CORS

Work Experience:
Staff Frontend Engineer | PixelCraft Solutions (2022 - Present)
- Led frontend architecture for an analytics platform processing 10M+ daily user events, achieving 99.9% uptime.
- Reduced Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) from 4.2s to 1.4s across core landing pages through dynamic route-based code splitting, image optimization, and resource prefetching.
- Architected a shared enterprise design system used by 45+ developers, decreasing feature delivery cycles by 30%.
- Mentored 8 junior and mid-level developers, establishing strict TypeScript guidelines and automated PR checks.

Senior Frontend Engineer | CloudMatrix Inc. (2019 - 2022)
- Migrated a legacy monolithic React app to a micro-frontend setup using Webpack Module Federation, enabling independent team deployments.
- Implemented client-side caching with React Query and Zustand, cutting redundant API fetch calls by 55%.
- Configured strict Content Security Policies (CSP) and automated XSS sanitization layers for financial transaction flows.
